about: What's new (builder list item 128). One entry per change, written once: what changed for the reader, not how it was built. `who` says who reads it: studio (a studio, every entry), owner (a business running its own site), client (a client in the portal, in the entry's `client` words, which never name Studio OS or show studio screens). Pictures are taken on sample data, never a client's site, by scripts/whats-new/shoot.spec.ts (WHATS_NEW_SHOOT=1 npx playwright test -c scripts/whats-new/playwright.config.ts). Newest first; the panel groups them by week.

entries.title: Your Search tab is a to-do list
entries.sentence: What would help you show up on Google, most important first, with a dot to tick off each one.
entries.alt: The Search tab’s to-do list on a sample site: Connect Google Search Console and Add a search description marked High, two more marked Medium.

entries.title: Every site’s numbers on Sites
entries.sentence: Each site shows its health, its visits and its Google clicks, with the change from last month. A drop is red.
entries.alt: The Sites table with three sample sites, each with its health score, visits and search clicks, and the change from last month.

entries.title: The client portal’s new look
entries.sentence: Your name and colours along the top, four tabs, the client’s to-dos in place, and every conversation behind one Messages door.
entries.alt: A sample client’s portal: the studio’s name along the top with Home, Messages, Documents and Help, and a welcome that says where everything lives.

client.title: Every conversation with your studio is now in Messages
client.sentence: Your to-dos sit at the top of your portal, and your documents, invoices and monthly reports are on one shelf.
client.alt: Your portal: your studio’s name along the top with Home, Messages, Documents and Help, and a welcome that says where everything lives.

entries.title: A bar for phones
entries.sentence: On a phone, visitors can see Call, Directions, Hours and Email along the bottom of every page of a site. Switch it on in Edit site, under the footer.
entries.alt: A sample restaurant’s website on a phone, with Call, Directions, Hours and Email along the bottom.

client.title: A bar for phones on your website
client.sentence: On a phone, your website can show Call, Directions, Hours and Email along the bottom of every page. Ask your studio to switch it on.

entries.title: Edit site has a new look
entries.sentence: One floating bar on top, your tools in a dock beside the page, and each section’s tools right beside it.
entries.alt: Edit site on a sample restaurant’s website: one floating bar along the top, and the dock with Pages, Add, Styles, Photos, Notes and Find.

entries.title: Real pictures when you choose a template
entries.sentence: The template and section pickers show each one as it really looks, drawn on sample content.
entries.alt: Three templates as the picker shows them, each drawn on the same sample restaurant.
